title: LMS Update
text: Estimate weights of least mean squares (LMS) adaptive filter, 5 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Algorithm} sets LMS adaptive algorithm LMS; {Filter length} sets the length of the filter, {Number of adaptive filters}, {Step size source} sets the method to specify the step, {Step size (mu)} sets the size of the adaptation step, {Leakage factor (0 to 1)}, {Initial value of filter weights}, {Adaptive filter mode}, {Enable adapt input} sets the update the filter weights, {Enable reset input} sets the reset the filter weights and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Mu
ports.summary: Filter adaptation step size 0.1 (default) | scalar in the range [0,1]

ports.name: Adapt
ports.summary: Update filter weights real scalar | vector

params.name: Algorithm
params.values: LMS adaptive algorithm LMS (default) | Normalized LMS | Sign—Error LMS | Sign—Data LMS | Sign—Sign LMS

params.name: Filter length
params.values: Length of the filter 32 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of adaptive filters
params.values: Number of adaptive filters 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Step size source
params.values: Method to specify the step size Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Step size (mu)
params.values: Size of the adaptation step 0.1 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Leakage factor (0 to 1)
params.values: Leakage factor 1.0 (default) | real scalar in the range [0,1]

params.name: Initial value of filter weights
params.values: Initial value of filter weights 0 (default) | real scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Adaptive filter mode
params.values: Adaptive filter mode Tapped delay-line FIR filter (default) | Adaptive linear combiner

params.name: Enable adapt input
params.values: Update the filter weights off (default) | on

params.name: Enable reset input
params.values: Reset the filter weights off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
